description: Header file defining register addresses, macros, and constants for hardware registers in a Linux driver for Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA, including register offsets, bit masks, and helper macros.

methods.name: writel
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: readl
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a memory-mapped register.
